name: LangSmith Remote MCP
summary: LangSmith-hosted MCP server exposing conversation history, prompts, runs and traces, datasets, experiments and billing; OAuth or API key.
description: Available on all LangSmith Cloud regions, BYOC and self-hosted v0.16+. Interactive clients use OAuth (RFC 8414 discovery); programmatic clients send an `X-Api-Key` header. Replaces the standalone langchain-ai/langsmith-mcp-server, which is archived and marked deprecated in the docs.

agent_access.notes: GCP US endpoint shown; other regions listed in the docs. API key via X-Api-Key for headless clients.
